title: Birdian
body:
# Birdian

Impact: 2

Race of avian people, their body covered in feathers, they are king of the skies.

## Powers

### Winged

You have Elytra wings without needing to equip any.

### Small

You are 1 and a half blocks tall.

### Flap

You can boost yourself forward by flapping your wings (space bar).

### Light Armor

You cant wear heavy armor.

### Aerial Combatant

You deal substantially more damage while in Elytra flight.

### Natural Armor

You have some natural protection from harm.

### Fragile

You have 3 less hearts than humans.

### Oviparous

Whenever you wake up in the morning, you will lay an egg.
